548  +     "coverage_ref_identity(jsonb)": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coverage_ref_identity(value "

550  +     " RETURNS text\n"
551  +     " LANGUAGE plpgsql\n"
552  +     " IMMUTABLE STRICT\n"

554  +     "AS $function$\n"
555  +     "BEGIN\n"
556  +     " IF NOT "
557  +     "COALESCE(public.coverage_json_keys(value,ARRAY['id','revision','kind','key'])\n"

639  +     "jsonb_build_object(\n"
640  +     "      'id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'implementation_id',\n"
641  +     "      "
642  +     "'reconciles_id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'reconciles_id',\n"

1255 +     "coverage_ref_identity(jsonb)": "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coverage_ref_identity(value "
1256 +     "jsonb)\n"
1257 +     " RETURNS text\n"
1258 +     " LANGUAGE plpgsql\n"
1259 +     " IMMUTABLE STRICT\n"
1260 +     " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\n"
1261 +     "AS $function$\n"
1262 +     "BEGIN\n"
1263 +     " IF NOT "
1264 +     "COALESCE(public.coverage_json_keys(value,ARRAY['id','revision','kind','key'])\n"
1265 +     "  AND jsonb_typeof(value->'id')='string'\n"
1266 +     "  AND jsonb_typeof(value->'revision')='number'\n"
1267 +     "  AND value->>'revision' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'\n"
1268 +     "  AND value->>'kind' IN "
1269 +     "('spec','part','bom','interface','engineering_configuration',\n"
1270 +     "   "
1271 +     "'build','sample','test_run','operation','tooling','fixture','sop','work_instruction',\n"
1272 +     "   "
1273 +     "'control_plan','manufacturing_baseline','pilot_run','manufacturing_release',\n"
1274 +     "   "
1275 +     "'customer_sample','supply_commitment','inventory','wip','training','evidence',\n"
1276 +     "   "
1277 +     "'issue','capa','field_feedback','manufacturing_configuration','graph_snapshot')\n"
1278 +     "  AND (value->'key'='null'::jsonb OR\n"
1279 +     "    (jsonb_typeof(value->'key')='string' AND length(value->>'key') "
1280 +     "BETWEEN 1 AND 120)),false)\n"
1281 +     " THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage fixed reference shape mismatch'; END "
1282 +     "IF;\n"
1283 +     " -- These casts also reject malformed UUIDs and out-of-range "
1284 +     "revisions.\n"
1285 +     " RETURN (value->>'kind')||':'||(value->>'id')::uuid::text||':'||\n"
1286 +     "  "
1287 +     "(value->>'revision')::integer::text||':'||COALESCE(value->>'key','');\n"
1288 +     "END $function$\n",

     -  'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coverage_ref_identity(value jsonb)\n'
     -  ' RETURNS text\n'
     -  ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
     -  ' IMMUTABLE STRICT\n'
     -  " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\n"
     -  'AS $function$\n'
     -  'BEGIN\n'
     -  " IF NOT COALESCE(public.coverage_json_keys(value,ARRAY['id','revision','kind','key'])\n"
     -  "  AND jsonb_typeof(value->'id')='string'\n"
     -  "  AND jsonb_typeof(value->'revision')='number'\n"
     -  "  AND value->>'revision' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'\n"
     -  "  AND value->>'kind' IN ('spec','part','bom','interface','engineering_configuration',\n"
     -  "   'build','sample','test_run','operation','tooling','fixture','sop','work_instruction',\n"
     -  "   'control_plan','manufacturing_baseline','pilot_run','manufacturing_release',\n"
     -  "   'customer_sample','supply_commitment','inventory','wip','training','evidence',\n"
     -  "   'issue','capa','manufacturing_configuration','graph_snapshot')\n"
     -  "  AND (value->'key'='null'::jsonb OR\n"
     -  "    (jsonb_typeof(value->'key')='string' AND length(value->>'key') BETWEEN 1 AND 120)),false)\n"
     -  " THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage fixed reference shape mismatch'; END IF;\n"
     -  ' -- These casts also reject malformed UUIDs and out-of-range revisions.\n'
     -  " RETURN (value->>'kind')||':'||(value->>'id')::uuid::text||':'||\n"
     -  "  (value->>'revision')::integer::text||':'||COALESCE(value->>'key','');\n"
     -  'END $function$\n',

     -  "      AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.fact_snapshot)='object'\n"

     -  '      '
     -  "'item_id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'item_id','intent_id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'intent_id',\n"
     -  '      '
     -  "'executor_id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'executor_id','outcome',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'outcome',\n"
     -  '      '

     -  "      'note',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'note','nature',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'nature')\n"
     -  "    OR (NEW.fact_snapshot->>'received_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.created_at\n"

2309 +     "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coverage_ref_identity(value jsonb)\n"
2310 +     " RETURNS text\n"
2311 +     " LANGUAGE plpgsql\n"
2312 +     " IMMUTABLE STRICT\n"
2313 +     " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\n"
2314 +     "AS $function$\n"
2315 +     "BEGIN\n"
2316 +     " IF NOT COALESCE(public.coverage_json_keys(value,ARRAY['id','revision','kind','key'])\n"
2317 +     "  AND jsonb_typeof(value->'id')='string'\n"
2318 +     "  AND jsonb_typeof(value->'revision')='number'\n"
2319 +     "  AND value->>'revision' ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'\n"
2320 +     "  AND value->>'kind' IN ('spec','part','bom','interface','engineering_configuration',\n"
2321 +     "   'build','sample','test_run','operation','tooling','fixture','sop','work_instruction',\n"
2322 +     "   'control_plan','manufacturing_baseline','pilot_run','manufacturing_release',\n"
2323 +     "   'customer_sample','supply_commitment','inventory','wip','training','evidence',\n"
2324 +     "   'issue','capa','manufacturing_configuration','graph_snapshot')\n"
2325 +     "  AND (value->'key'='null'::jsonb OR\n"
2326 +     "    (jsonb_typeof(value->'key')='string' AND length(value->>'key') BETWEEN 1 AND 120)),false)\n"
2327 +     " THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'coverage fixed reference shape mismatch'; END IF;\n"
2328 +     " -- These casts also reject malformed UUIDs and out-of-range revisions.\n"
2329 +     " RETURN (value->>'kind')||':'||(value->>'id')::uuid::text||':'||\n"
2330 +     "  (value->>'revision')::integer::text||':'||COALESCE(value->>'key','');\n"
2331 +     "END $function$\n",
2332 +     "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protect_change_implementation_capture()\n"
2333 +     " RETURNS trigger\n"
2334 +     " LANGUAGE plpgsql\n"
2335 +     " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\n"
2336 +     "AS $function$\n"
2337 +     "DECLARE parent change_request_versions%ROWTYPE; o jsonb; item jsonb;\n"
2338 +     "BEGIN\n"
2339 +     "  SELECT * INTO STRICT parent FROM change_request_versions\n"
2340 +     "    WHERE tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id AND product_id=NEW.product_id\n"
2341 +     "      AND project_id=NEW.project_id AND change_id=NEW.change_id\n"
2342 +     "      AND id=NEW.change_version_id AND revision=NEW.change_revision;\n"
2343 +     "  SELECT v INTO STRICT o FROM jsonb_array_elements(parent.request_snapshot->'orders') v\n"
2344 +     "    WHERE (v->>'id')::uuid=NEW.order_id;\n"
2345 +     "  SELECT v INTO STRICT item FROM jsonb_array_elements(o->'plan'->'items') v\n"
2346 +     "    WHERE (v->>'id')::uuid=NEW.item_id;\n"
2347 +     "  IF parent.status NOT IN ('approved','implementing')\n"
2348 +     "    OR ROW(parent.owner_id,parent.visibility) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.owner_id,NEW.visibility)\n"
2349 +     "    OR NOT COALESCE(jsonb_typeof(NEW.occurrence_snapshot)='object'\n"
2350 +     "      AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.fact_snapshot)='object'\n"
2351 +     "      AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.sources)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.sources)>0\n"
2352 +     "      AND jsonb_typeof(NEW.required_source_read_set)='array'\n"
2353 +     "      AND jsonb_array_length(NEW.required_source_read_set)>0,false)\n"
2354 +     "    OR NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM "
2355 +     "'pdos-change-implementation-occurrence-v2'\n"
2356 +     "    OR NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'scope' IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(\n"
2357 +     "      'tenant_id',NEW.tenant_id,'product_id',NEW.product_id,'project_id',NEW.project_id)\n"
2358 +     "    OR (NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'change_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.change_id\n"
2359 +     "    OR (NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'order_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.order_id\n"
2360 +     "    OR (NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'item_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.item_id\n"
2361 +     "    OR (NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'implementation_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.fact_id\n"
2362 +     "    OR (NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'executor_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.executor_id\n"
2363 +     "    OR NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'operation' IS DISTINCT FROM 'change.implementation.record'\n"
2364 +     "    OR (NEW.occurrence_snapshot->>'intent_id')::uuid IS DISTINCT FROM (item->'intent'->>'id')::uuid\n"
2365 +     "    OR NEW.fact_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_build_object(\n"
2366 +     "      'id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'implementation_id',\n"
2367 +     "      'reconciles_id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'reconciles_id',\n"
2368 +     "      "
2369 +     "'item_id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'item_id','intent_id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'intent_id',\n"
2370 +     "      "
2371 +     "'executor_id',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'executor_id','outcome',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'outcome',\n"
2372 +     "      "
2373 +     "'occurred_at',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'occurred_at','received_at',NEW.fact_snapshot->'received_at',\n"
2374 +     "      'sources',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'sources','outputs',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'outputs',\n"
2375 +     "      'note',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'note','nature',NEW.occurrence_snapshot->'nature')\n"
2376 +     "    OR (NEW.fact_snapshot->>'received_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.created_at\n"
2377 +     "    OR NOT COALESCE((NEW.fact_snapshot->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz<=NEW.created_at\n"
2378 +     "      AND NEW.created_at<=clock_timestamp()\n"
2379 +     "      AND (o->'plan'->>'expires_at' IS NULL OR\n"
2380 +     "        (NEW.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND "
2381 +     "NEW.expires_at<=(o->'plan'->>'expires_at')::timestamptz)),false)\n"
2382 +     "    OR NOT COALESCE(NEW.sources @> (NEW.fact_snapshot->'sources'),false)\n"
2383 +     "    OR NOT COALESCE(o->'required_disciplines' @> "
2384 +     '\'["engineering","manufacturing"]\'::jsonb,false)\n'
2385 +     "    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(o->'required_disciplines') d\n"
2386 +     "      WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(o->'approvals') a\n"
2387 +     "        WHERE a->'discipline'=d AND "
